newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman starts Serfin.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman starts Serfin.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs analyst Daniel Abut said on Monday he started Grupo Financiero Serfin with a market underperform rating.
-- He said the company's American Depositary Receipts were overvalued. "The fundamentals are improving but still remain challenging."
-- Abut said a target share price for Serfin would be $3.63. Shares were trading at 4-3/4, down 1/8, early afternoon on Monday.
-- He added that the share price did not reflect the dilution corresponding with Serfin's recapitalization.
